one_liner: Web data platform: proxies, scraping APIs, datasets, and MCP server.

evidence.claim: Bright Data offers two auth methods: API key/token and native proxy username/password
evidence.quote: **API Access** - Authenticate and interact with the Bright Data platform using an API key/token.

evidence.claim: Scraper Studio API calls authenticate via Bearer token header
evidence.quote: Every Bright Data Scraper Studio API call uses bearer-token authentication.

evidence.claim: A default API key is created automatically at account signup, enabling self-serve credentials
evidence.quote: We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.

evidence.claim: Free tier available without a credit card
evidence.quote: with **5,000 free credits per month**. No credit card required.

evidence.claim: Vendor officially documents and ships its own MCP server
evidence.quote: The Bright Data MCP server gives AI agents and assistants real-time access to public web data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

notes: Broad surface: proxy networks, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, Scraper Studio (POST /dca/trigger, GET /dca/dataset), datasets marketplace, plus Python/JS SDKs and a CLI. API keys support 5 permission levels and optional expiration. Native proxy auth uses brd-customer-{id}-zone-{name} username/password format. Scraper Studio quickstart lists 'a payment method on file' as a prerequisite, but a no-credit-card free tier exists. Official MCP server documented on vendor docs and brightdata GitHub org (brightdata/skills).
